questions.stem: All of the following tests mentioned below are related to the synthetic function of hepatocytes except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Serum γ-glutamyl transpeptidase
  • Serum γ-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT) is related to the excretory function of liver hepatocyte


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 822

questions.stem: Which of the following statement are true regarding acute liver injury:
questions.solutionHtml:
All of the above
  • Acute liver injury refers to a sudden and severe impairment of liver function.It can have a range of presentations and severity levels.
  • All the statements given above are true with respect to Acute liver injury, hence the answer D: All of the above is the correct option.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 825-26
